#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1000000009;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cin >> a[i];
    vector<int> odd(n);
    if (a[0] % 2 == 1)
        odd[0] = 1;
    else
        odd[0] = -1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 1)
            odd[i] = odd[i-1] + 1;
        else
            odd[i] = odd[i-1] - 1;
    }
    vector<int> price(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n-1; i++) {
        price[i] = abs(a[i+1] - a[i]);
    }
    vector<int> prices;
    for (int i = 1; i < n-1; i++) {
        if (odd[i] == 0) {
            prices.push_back(price[i]);
        }
    }
    sort(prices.begin(), prices.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i : prices) {
        if (b - i >= 0) {
            b -= i;
            ans++;
        } else break;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
